extract_batch with one valid URI input and one that downloads to an unparseable document

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const xberg = @import("xberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try xberg.extract_batch("[{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/text/plain.txt\"},{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/pdf/corrupt_truncated.pdf\"}]", "{}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
